title: Neural Defend Ranks #1 in Global Audio Deepfake Detection Benchmark - ARCAS on the Podonos Independent Leaderboard
abstract: arXiv:2611.27215v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Commercial detectors of AI-generated audio are usually promoted with results on internal test sets that buyers cannot inspect. Independent benchmarks with private labels give a more reliable comparison. We report the results of Neural Defend's ARCAS foundation models on the Podonos audio deepfake detection benchmark, an independent leaderboard that scores commercial detection APIs and open-source detectors on one held-out set of real speech and speech from current text-to-speech and voice-cloning systems, delivered in six file formats, against labels that only Podonos holds. In the release of 29 October 2026, which covers 28 systems from 16 commercial vendors and the leading open models, ARCAS 290M and the smaller ARCAS 90M share first place, ahead of every other commercial system, including Resemble AI, Hiya, Pindrop, Hive, and Reality Defender. translated_title: Neural Defend 在全球音频深度伪造检测基准测试中排名第一——ARCAS 亮相 Podonos 独立排行榜
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.27215v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：AI 生成音频的商用检测器通常以买家无法查验的内部测试集结果进行宣传推广。而带有私有标签的独立基准测试能提供更可靠的比较。我们报告了 Neural Defend 公司的 ARCAS 基础模型在 Podonos 音频深度伪造检测基准测试上的成绩。该基准是一个独立排行榜，在一组保留测试集上对商用检测 API 和开源检测器进行评分，测试集包含真实语音以及来自当前文本转语音（TTS）和语音克隆系统的语音，以六种文件格式提供，且标签仅由 Podonos 掌握。在 2026 年 10 月 29 日发布的榜单中，涵盖了来自 16 家商用供应商的 28 个系统以及领先的开源模型，ARCAS 290M 与较小的 ARCAS 90M 并列第一，超越了包括 Resemble AI、Hiya、Pindrop、Hive 和 Reality Defender 在内的所有其他商用系统。两个模型的错误率均低于所有其他系统，且在统计学上具有显著差距……
tldr: Neural Defend 的 ARCAS 基础模型（290M 与 90M）在 Podonos 独立音频深度伪造检测基准上并列第一，以统计学上显著的优势超越 Resemble AI、Hiya、Pindrop、Hive 等所有其他商用及开源检测系统。
en_tdlr: Neural Defend's ARCAS foundation models (290M and 90M) tied for first place on the independent Podonos audio deepfake detection benchmark, outperforming all other commercial and open-source systems—including Resemble AI, Hiya, Pindrop, Hive, and Reality Defender—by a statistically clear margin.
